versions.content: Name Can Trcv_ Config Type Kind Structure Elements Implementation specific Type -- Comment -- Description This is the type of the external data structure containing the overall initialization data for the CAN transceiver driver and settings affecting all transceivers. Furthermore it contains pointers to transceiver configuration structures. The contents of the initialization data structure are CAN transceiver hardware specific. Available via Can Trcv.h
